caption:
Two movements. 90 reps. Your shoulders will hate you. 💪

September 2003: CrossFit Journal Issue 13 introduces six benchmark workouts with women's names: Angie, Barbara, Chelsea, Diane, Elizabeth and Fran. Elizabeth is 21-15-9 cleans (135/95 lb) and ring dips. That's 45 cleans and 45 dips on unstable rings. Squat clean or power clean is your call, but pick one and stick with it. It's meant to be fast: scale it so you finish in under 10 minutes. No ring dips yet? Try 15-12-9 with push-ups and a lighter bar.
